title: 第三章 挟持第四章 美食解人忧
lines: 听到张寿坦言门当户对，又见朱公权步步紧逼，甚至连爹一直以来供养人家母子的底细都拆穿了，朱莹不禁有些心疼这个给自己留下完美第一印象的清雅少年，刚刚那个大胆的主意一下子变成了决心，霍然站起身来。
“什么婚事，我可不承认！”
这一站起来，朱莹便发现，朱公权果然露出了一丝窃喜，分明是以为刚刚那番话语成功奏效，激怒了她。她也乐得麻痹这个眼瞎到给二哥当走狗的朱府幕僚，径直走到了张寿跟前。
张寿原本正在走神，听这一声喝，他一回神就发现，眼前光线突然被遮挡了，抬头一看，却只见朱莹不知道什么时候来到了自己身前。四目对视，他甚至能看清楚对方眼睛里那漆黑的瞳仁，感受到那瞳仁中激荡的那股冲动。
下一刻，他就只听她猛然叱喝了一声，随即，人如同蝴蝶穿花一般闪到了他身后，接着，他的喉咙就被一只手给扣住了。这样的变化让他错愕非常，可紧跟着就听到了一句低语。
“帮我个忙，演场戏糊弄一下那个讨厌家伙！”
张寿只觉得耳畔吹气如兰，继而又是一声娇叱：“全都给我让开！”
他简直又好气又好笑。脖子上能感觉到那只手的温润触感，没有薄茧，没有突出的指节，可他的眼力到底不差，只瞧刚刚她那利落的动作，就知道这位千金大小姐是扎扎实实练过的。然而，即便没有她在耳边的提醒，他也能感觉到，那手只是轻轻碰到他的脖子，不曾用力。
想到今日是他这波澜不惊的三年中最有意思的一天，他到底没有反抗。
不就是演场戏吗？那我就陪你演吧！
见这一幕，吴氏吓得不轻。她下意识地就要冲上去把张寿给救回来，却不想朱公权突然闪身挡在她跟前，惶急之际，她求助地看向几个侍卫，却发现人人眼神幽深，岿然不动，张寿正被人挟持着步步后退，她不禁心急如焚。
张寿非常默契地配合大小姐那生怕弄疼了他似的锁喉，跟着她退出门时，他眼角余光突然瞥见那高高的门槛，连忙用极低的声音提醒道：“小心门槛！”
朱莹原本一心只警惕朱公权和那几个侍卫会出手阻拦自己，还真没注意身后有门槛，等听到这话，她连忙迅速往后瞥了一眼，一时对张寿更生好感。
这真是个长得好性格更好的美少年！有谁会在被人突然挟持时，还为挟持者着想？
不行，她以后一定得好好教教他，日后对人一定要有防范之心，否则很容易受骗上当！
眼见出了厅堂也没人追出来，张寿迅速扫了一眼前院，发现老刘头知情识趣地缩在墙角，厨房门口，厨娘刘婶和仆人阿六正在探头探脑，总之一个个都是满脸看热闹的表情，他只觉得自己简直是在敬业地配合人演独角戏。
出了宅院大门，他瞅了瞅那些车马，原本还以为她会去劫一匹马，可意想不到的是，她竟然根本没有停顿半步，而是一边依旧扣着他喉咙，一边拖着他继续往前走。直到上了一处田埂，他终于忍不住了，索性便装作脚下失足。
他本待往后仰头轻轻一撞，借以猫腰一缩脱困，可没想到的是，见他失足，身后那位大小姐果断放弃了挟持的动作，竟是立时三刻伸手稳稳搀扶起了他。
“你……你没事吧？是不是崴了脚？要不要紧？”
听到这连声追问，张寿再一次确定，这位大小姐确实一点恶意都没有。
当下，站稳的他便笑着摇头：“我没事，倒是大小姐要我演这么一场戏，到底想干什么？”
朱莹这才放下了手，站直身子，眉眼含笑地问道：“我是赵国公之女朱莹，你呢？”
见她自报家门，张寿也就爽快自我介绍：“我是张寿。”
“张寿……张寿……”朱莹一口气连念了两遍，随即又打量了张寿几眼。
她刚刚一时起意挟持他，其实是为了和他单独说几句话，问一问爹定下的所谓婚事。
她立刻赔礼道：“刚刚挟持你脱身，我也是不得已，实在对不住！你之前也看到了，那个朱公权言语可憎，有些话我不想当着他的面问，可我要私底下和你说话，他一定会从中作梗。他希望我退婚，所以乐得看我和你闹起来！”
“张寿，我只想问一件事，你真的从来都没听说过我们那婚约吗？”
张寿没有立刻回答这个问题，而是抬头瞧了一眼不远处自家那在乡野之地非常显眼的屋宅，眼见到现在为止仍然没有一个人追出来，他想起之前那个朱公权在田头拿他对朱莹打比方的事情，不禁隐隐有个念头。
原来，我这穿越也遭遇了退婚流？
事情发生在别人的书里，难免让人因为主角的遭遇同仇敌忾，可发生在自己身上……
他居然有些期待后续发展！
毕竟，虽说眼前的红衣少女令人赏心悦目，为人也算通情达理，可要说立时三刻把她当成共度一生的人生伴侣，张寿还真的没法接受，虽说这位大小姐比他前世里见过的任何女人都更漂亮，而且是纯天然无添加的那种艳光四射。
不管自由恋爱好不好，但是……包办婚姻一生黑！
他还没离开乡间去这个陌生的世上逛一圈，那么早谈婚论嫁干什么！
想到这里，他极其坦然地说：“我从小就生活在这，没去过更远的地方，从没听说过自己还有个未婚妻，因而这所谓婚约，大小姐就不必再提了。”
如果张寿面目可憎，那么他说了这话之后，自从那些坏消息传来，家中景况突变，背负着颇大压力的朱莹也许会如释重负。可是，张寿如此简单直接的表态，却让她有一种被人嫌弃的感觉。
可偏偏就在这时候，心情有些郁闷的她突然听到了咕的一声！
张寿正心想自己都如此“剖明心迹”了，怎么没有反应，可紧跟着就听到这不小的动静。他先是为之愕然，等看到面前的千金大小姐突然发窘，他立刻就明白了是怎么回事。
“光顾着说话，都忘了这会儿是午饭的时辰！怎么，你是饿了？”
糟糕，被二哥气得几天没好好吃饭，居然这时候饿了！
就在朱莹绞尽脑汁想岔开话题时，她偏偏又听到自己的肚子不争气地再次咕咕叫了一声。
她恨不得找条地缝钻下去，可张寿却越发笑吟吟：“看来你是真饿了。如果你不想回去见你家那个讨厌的清客相公，那咱们就去其他地方祭祀一下五脏庙，顺便好好聊一聊？”
content_en:
Hearing Zhang Shou's confession that he was a good match, and seeing Zhu Gongquan pressuring him step by step, even exposing the truth about his father's support for his mother and son, Zhu Ying couldn't help but feel a little sorry for this elegant young man who had left a perfect first impression on her. The bold idea just now suddenly turned into determination, and she stood up suddenly.
"What kind of marriage, I won't admit it!"
As soon as she stood up, Zhu Ying found that Zhu Gongquan actually showed a hint of joy. He clearly thought that the words he just said had worked and angered her. She was also happy to paralyze this Zhu Mansion aide who was so blind that he was working as a lackey for her second brother, and walked straight to Zhang Shou.
Zhang Shou was originally distracted when he heard the shout. As soon as he came back to his senses, he found that the light in front of him was suddenly blocked. When he looked up, he saw Zhu Ying arriving in front of him at some point. Looking into each other's eyes, he could even clearly see the dark pupils in the other person's eyes and feel the impulse surging in those pupils.
The next moment, he heard her suddenly yelling, and immediately, someone flashed behind him like a butterfly piercing a flower, and then, his throat was grabbed by a hand. This change made him very surprised, but then he heard a whisper.
"Do me a favor and put on a show to fool that annoying guy!"
Zhang Shou felt as if the breath was like orchid in his ears, and then he yelled again: "Get out of my way, everyone!"
He was just so angry and funny. He could feel the warm touch of that hand on his neck. There were no calluses or protruding knuckles, but his eyesight was not bad after all. Just by looking at her neat movements just now, he knew that this rich lady had been well-trained. However, even without her reminder in his ear, he could still feel that the hand only touched his neck lightly without any force.
Thinking that today was the most interesting day in his three uneventful years, he didn't resist.
Isn't it just a show? Then I will act with you!
Seeing this scene, Wu was frightened. She subconsciously wanted to rush forward to rescue Zhang Shou, but she didn't expect that Zhu Gongquan suddenly stepped in front of her. In panic, she looked at several guards for help, only to find that they all had deep eyes and remained motionless. Zhang Shou was being held hostage and was retreating step by step. She couldn't help but feel anxious.
Zhang Shou cooperated tacitly with the eldest lady's chokehold as if she was afraid of hurting him. When he followed her out of the door, he suddenly caught a glimpse of the high threshold from the corner of his eye, and quickly reminded him in a very low voice: "Be careful with the threshold!"
Zhu Ying was originally only wary that Zhu Gongquan and the guards would try to stop her, but she really didn't notice that there was a threshold behind her. When she heard this, she quickly glanced back and suddenly felt good about Zhang Shougeng.
This is really a beautiful boy with good looks and a better personality! Who would think about the kidnappers when they are suddenly kidnapped?
No, she must teach him a lesson in the future and be wary of others in the future, otherwise she will be easily deceived!
Seeing that no one was chasing him out of the hall, Zhang Shou quickly glanced at the front yard and found that Old Liu Tou was huddled in the corner knowingly. At the door of the kitchen, the cook Aunt Liu and the servant Ah Liu were poking their heads. In short, they all looked at the excitement on their faces. He just felt that he was simply cooperating with others in a one-man show.
After leaving the gate of the house, he took a look at the carriages and horses. He originally thought that she would rob a horse, but to his surprise, she didn't stop at all, but continued to drag him forward while still holding his throat. It wasn't until he reached a field ridge that he finally couldn't bear it any longer and pretended to have lost his footing.
He was about to tilt his head back and hit him lightly to get out of trouble, but what he didn't expect was that when he lost his footing, the young lady behind him decisively gave up on holding him hostage, and immediately reached out to help him up steadily.
"Are you...are you okay? Did you sprain your foot? Is it okay?"
Hearing these repeated questions, Zhang Shou once again confirmed that this young lady did not have any malicious intentions at all.
At that moment, standing firm, he smiled and shook his head: "I'm fine, but the eldest lady wants me to act in such a scene. What do you want to do?"
Zhu Ying then put down her hand, stood up straight, and asked with a smile on her face: "I am Zhu Ying, the daughter of Duke Zhao, and you?"
Seeing her announcing her family name, Zhang Shou readily introduced himself: "I am Zhang Shou."
"Zhang Shou... Zhang Shou..." Zhu Ying read it twice in one breath, and then looked at Zhang Shou again.
She just kidnapped him on the spur of the moment, but actually she wanted to have a few words with him alone and ask about the so-called marriage that her father had decided.
She immediately apologized and said, "I just kidnapped you and escaped. I had no choice but to apologize! You have seen it before. That Zhu Gongquan's words are abominable. There are some things I don't want to ask in front of him, but if I want to talk to you in private, he will definitely get in the way. He wants me to break off the engagement, so he is happy to see me quarrel with you!"
"Zhang Shou, I just want to ask one thing. Have you really never heard of our engagement?"
Zhang Shou did not answer the question immediately, but looked up at his house not far away, which was very conspicuous in the countryside. Seeing that no one had chased him out so far, he remembered that Zhu Gongquan had compared him to Zhu Ying in the field, and he couldn't help but have a vague idea.
It turns out that I also encountered the annulment of my engagement during this time travel?
If something happens in someone else's book, it's inevitable that people will share the same hatred and hatred for what happened to the protagonist, but if it happens to me...
He actually looked forward to the follow-up development!
After all, although the girl in red in front of him was pleasing to the eye and reasonable, Zhang Shou really couldn't accept the fact that he immediately regarded her as his lifelong partner, even though this eldest lady was more beautiful than any woman he had ever seen in his previous life, and she was all natural and radiant without any additives.
No matter whether free love is good or not, but...arranged marriage is a black mark for life!
He hasn't left the country yet to wander around this strange world, so why are he talking about marriage so early?
Thinking of this, he said very calmly: "I have lived here since I was a child. I have never been to any place farther away. I have never heard that I have a fiancée. Therefore, I don't need to mention this so-called engagement."
If Zhang Shou looks hateful, then after he said this, Zhu Ying, who was under a lot of pressure since the bad news came and the family situation changed suddenly, might feel relieved. However, Zhang Shou's simple and direct statement made her feel rejected.
But just at this moment, she was feeling a little depressed and suddenly heard a cooing sound!
Zhang Shouzheng thought that he had "expressed his feelings" like this, why didn't he respond, but then he heard this big noise. He was shocked at first, but when he saw the rich young lady in front of him suddenly embarrassed, he immediately understood what was going on.
"I was so busy talking that I forgot it's lunch time! What, are you hungry?"
Oops, I was so angry with my second brother that I haven’t eaten properly for several days, and now I’m actually hungry!
Just when Zhu Ying was racking her brains to change the topic, she heard her stomach growling unsatisfactorily again.
She wanted to find a crack in the ground to crawl under, but Zhang Shou smiled more and more: "It seems that you are really hungry. If you don't want to go back to see your annoying Qingke husband, then let's go to another place to worship the five internal organs temple and have a good chat by the way?"
title_en: Chapter 3: Hijacking Chapter 4: Delicious food to relieve people’s worries
